teacher_attendance_complete.name: teacher_attendance_complete
teacher_attendance_complete.value: (teacher_attendance_status IS NULL) OR ((teacher_attendance_marked_at IS NOT NULL) AND (teacher_attendance_marked_by IS NOT NULL))

classes_archive_pair.name: classes_archive_pair
classes_archive_pair.value: (status = 'archived'::text) OR ((archived_at IS NULL) AND (archived_by IS NULL))

students_trial_pair.name: students_trial_pair
students_trial_pair.value: (trial_class_id IS NULL) OR (trial_started_at IS NOT NULL)

enrollment_joined_in_term.name: enrollment_joined_in_term
enrollment_joined_in_term.value: (joined_at >= term_start) AND ((term_end IS NULL) OR (joined_at <= term_end))

enrollment_open_has_no_end.name: enrollment_open_has_no_end
enrollment_open_has_no_end.value: ((status = ANY (ARRAY['trial'::text, 'active'::text, 'on_leave'::text])) AND (ended_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = ANY (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'transferred'::text, 'dropped'::text])) AND (ended_at IS NOT NULL) AND (ended_at >= joined_at))

attendance_void_complete.name: attendance_void_complete
attendance_void_complete.value: (is_voided = false) OR ((voided_at IS NOT NULL) AND (voided_by IS NOT NULL))

evaluation_term_order.name: evaluation_term_order
evaluation_term_order.value: (term_end IS NULL) OR (term_start IS NULL) OR (term_end >= term_start)

assignment_questions_level_check.name: assignment_questions_level_check
assignment_questions_level_check.value: level = ANY (ARRAY['Nhận biết'::text, 'Thông hiểu'::text, 'Vận dụng thấp'::text, 'Vận dụng cao'::text])

knowledge_target_shape.name: knowledge_target_shape
knowledge_target_shape.value: ((target_type = 'grade'::text) AND (grade IS NOT NULL)) OR ((target_type = 'class'::text) AND (class_id IS NOT NULL)) OR (target_type = 'global'::text)

ledger_period_shape.name: ledger_period_shape
ledger_period_shape.value: (period_type IS NULL) OR ((period_type = 'monthly'::text) AND (month IS NOT NULL)) OR ((period_type = 'course'::text) AND (term_start IS NOT NULL))

ledger_term_order.name: ledger_term_order
ledger_term_order.value: (term_end IS NULL) OR (term_start IS NULL) OR (term_end >= term_start)

receipt_void_complete.name: receipt_void_complete
receipt_void_complete.value: (status <> 'void'::text) OR ((voided_at IS NOT NULL) AND (voided_by IS NOT NULL))

wallet_direction_scope.name: wallet_direction_scope
wallet_direction_scope.value: ((type = 'adjustment'::text) AND (direction IS NOT NULL)) OR ((type <> 'adjustment'::text) AND (direction IS NULL))

wallet_void_complete.name: wallet_void_complete
wallet_void_complete.value: (status <> 'void'::text) OR ((voided_at IS NOT NULL) AND (voided_by IS NOT NULL))

expense_wallet_refund_shape.name: expense_wallet_refund_shape
expense_wallet_refund_shape.value: (type IS DISTINCT FROM 'wallet_refund'::text) OR ((student_id IS NOT NULL) AND (wallet_transaction_id IS NOT NULL))

course_closing_approved_complete.name: course_closing_approved_complete
course_closing_approved_complete.value: (approval_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'approved'::text) OR ((approved_at IS NOT NULL) AND (approved_by IS NOT NULL))

course_closing_invalidated_complete.name: course_closing_invalidated_complete
course_closing_invalidated_complete.value: (approval_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'invalidated'::text) OR ((invalidated_at IS NOT NULL) AND (invalidated_reason IS NOT NULL))

closing_document_ready_has_file.name: closing_document_ready_has_file
closing_document_ready_has_file.value: (status <> 'ready'::text) OR ((storage_path IS NOT NULL) AND (generated_at IS NOT NULL))

availability_slot_time_order.name: availability_slot_time_order
availability_slot_time_order.value: (end_time IS NULL) OR (start_time IS NULL) OR (end_time > start_time)

job_completion_order.name: job_completion_order
job_completion_order.value: (completed_at IS NULL) OR (started_at IS NULL) OR (completed_at >= started_at)

public.allowed_teachers.name: allowed_teachers
public.allowed_teachers.definition: SELECT email, role, added_at, added_by_admin FROM staff_email_access WHERE status = 'allowed'::text

public.blocked_teachers.name: blocked_teachers
public.blocked_teachers.definition: SELECT email, blocked_at, blocked_by FROM staff_email_access WHERE status = 'blocked'::text

public.v_class_current_term.name: v_class_current_term
public.v_class_current_term.definition: SELECT DISTINCT ON (class_id) class_id, id AS term_id, course_id, name AS term_name, term_start, term_end, tuition_fee, currency, start_time, days_of_week, term_end IS NULL OR term_end >= CURRENT_DATE AS is_open FROM class_terms t ORDER BY class_id, term_start DESC

public.v_class_term_student_counts.name: v_class_term_student_counts
public.v_class_term_student_counts.definition: SELECT class_id, term_start, count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'active'::text) AS active, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'trial'::text) AS trial, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on_leave'::text) AS on_leave, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'dropped'::text) AS dropped, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed'::text) AS completed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'transferred'::text) AS promoted FROM student_course_enrollments e GROUP BY class_id, term_start

public.v_class_student_counts.name: v_class_student_counts
public.v_class_student_counts.definition: SELECT c.id AS class_id, COALESCE(n.total, 0::bigint) AS total, COALESCE(n.active, 0::bigint) AS active, COALESCE(n.trial, 0::bigint) AS trial, COALESCE(n.on_leave, 0::bigint) AS on_leave, COALESCE(n.dropped, 0::bigint) AS dropped, COALESCE(n.completed, 0::bigint) AS completed, COALESCE(n.promoted, 0::bigint) AS promoted FROM classes c LEFT JOIN v_class_current_term ct ON ct.class_id = c.id LEFT JOIN v_class_term_student_counts n ON n.class_id = c.id AND n.term_start = ct.term_start

public.v_ledger_totals.name: v_ledger_totals
public.v_ledger_totals.definition: SELECT l.id AS ledger_id, COALESCE(sum(a.amount), 0::numeric) AS paid_total, COALESCE(sum(a.discount_amount), 0::numeric) AS discount_total, COALESCE(sum(a.sibling_discount_amount), 0::numeric) AS sibling_discount_total, l.amount - COALESCE(sum(a.amount), 0::numeric) - COALESCE(sum(a.discount_amount), 0::numeric) AS outstanding, count(a.id) AS allocation_count FROM course_fee_ledgers l LEFT JOIN receipt_allocations a ON a.ledger_id = l.id LEFT JOIN receipts r ON r.id = a.receipt_id AND r.status = 'posted'::text WHERE a.id IS NULL OR r.id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id, l.amount

public.v_student_wallet_balance.name: v_student_wallet_balance
public.v_student_wallet_balance.definition: SELECT s.id AS student_id, COALESCE(w.opening_balance, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(sum( CASE t.type WHEN 'deposit'::text THEN t.amount WHEN 'credit'::text THEN t.amount WHEN 'allocation'::text THEN - t.amount WHEN 'refund'::text THEN - t.amount WHEN 'adjustment'::text THEN CASE WHEN t.direction = 'out'::text THEN - t.amount ELSE t.amount END ELSE NULL::numeric END), 0::numeric) AS balance, COALESCE(w.opening_balance, 0::numeric) AS opening_balance, w.history_started_at, count(t.id) AS posted_transaction_count FROM students s LEFT JOIN student_wallets w ON w.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN wallet_transactions t ON t.student_id = s.id AND t.status = 'posted'::text GROUP BY s.id, w.opening_balance, w.history_started_at

public.v_student_current_enrollment.name: v_student_current_enrollment
public.v_student_current_enrollment.definition: SELECT e.student_id, e.id AS enrollment_id, e.class_id, c.teacher_id, e.term_start, e.term_end, e.status, e.joined_at FROM student_course_enrollments e JOIN classes c ON c.id = e.class_id WHERE e.status = ANY (ARRAY['trial'::text, 'active'::text, 'on_leave'::text])

public.mv_accounting_student_summary.name: mv_accounting_student_summary
public.mv_accounting_student_summary.definition: SELECT s.id AS student_id, s.code AS student_code, s.name AS student_name, s.name_normalized AS student_name_normalized, s.student_lifecycle, cur.class_id AS current_class_id, cur.enrollment_id AS current_enrollment_id, cur.status AS current_enrollment_status, COALESCE(agg.class_count, 0::bigint) AS class_count, COALESCE(agg.course_count, 0::bigint) AS course_count, COALESCE(agg.total_paid, 0::numeric) AS total_paid, COALESCE(agg.total_outstanding, 0::numeric) AS total_outstanding, COALESCE(agg.overdue_course_count, 0::bigint) AS overdue_course_count, COALESCE(wb.balance, 0::numeric) AS wallet_balance, COALESCE(nl.reminder_count, 0::bigint) AS tuition_reminder_count, nl.last_reminder_at, now() AS rebuilt_at FROM students s LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT e.class_id, e.id AS enrollment_id, e.status FROM student_course_enrollments e WHERE e.student_id = s.id AND (e.status = ANY (ARRAY['trial'::text, 'active'::text, 'on_leave'::text])) ORDER BY e.term_start DESC LIMIT 1) cur ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(DISTINCT l.class_id) AS class_count, count(*) AS course_count, sum(vt.paid_total) AS total_paid, sum(GREATEST(vt.outstanding, 0::numeric)) AS total_outstanding, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (l.status = ANY (ARRAY['unpaid'::text, 'partial'::text])) AND l.due_date IS NOT NULL AND l.due_date < CURRENT_DATE) AS overdue_course_count FROM course_fee_ledgers l JOIN v_ledger_totals vt ON vt.ledger_id = l.id WHERE l.student_id = s.id) agg ON true LEFT JOIN v_student_wallet_balance wb ON wb.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS reminder_count, max(n.sent_at) AS last_reminder_at FROM ledger_notice_log n JOIN course_fee_ledgers l2 ON l2.id = n.ledger_id WHERE l2.student_id = s.id) nl ON true

public.mv_admin_class_tuition_summary.name: mv_admin_class_tuition_summary
public.mv_admin_class_tuition_summary.definition: SELECT l.class_id, l.term_start, count(*) AS ledger_count, sum(l.amount) AS total_amount, sum(vt.paid_total) AS total_paid, sum(vt.discount_total) AS total_discount, sum(GREATEST(vt.outstanding, 0::numeric)) AS total_outstanding, count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.status = 'paid'::text) AS paid_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.status = 'partial'::text) AS partial_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.status = 'unpaid'::text) AS unpaid_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.status = 'waived'::text) AS waived_count, now() AS rebuilt_at FROM course_fee_ledgers l JOIN v_ledger_totals vt ON vt.ledger_id = l.id WHERE l.term_start IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.class_id, l.term_start
